scenarios.name: teller-debit
scenarios.why: teller (FACILTYPE not 496) debit: SELECT +0, both balances reduced, UPDATE +0, PROCTRAN 'DEB' 'COUNTER WTHDRW' at the clock's date/time, 'Y' '0'

scenarios.name: teller-credit
scenarios.why: teller credit: COMM-AMT >= 0 skips the debit checks, UPDATE, PROCTRAN 'CRE' 'COUNTER RECVED', 'Y'

scenarios.name: payment-debit
scenarios.why: payment debit (FACILTYPE 496) with funds: WS-DIFFERENCE >= 0, PROCTRAN 'PDR' with COMM-ORIGIN(1:14) as the description

scenarios.name: payment-credit
scenarios.why: payment credit to a SAVING account: PROCTRAN 'PCR' with COMM-ORIGIN(1:14)

scenarios.name: payment-debit-insufficient
scenarios.why: payment debit one cent beyond the available balance (100.00): WS-DIFFERENCE < 0 and 496, 'N' '3', no UPDATE, no PROCTRAN

scenarios.name: payment-debit-exact-balance
scenarios.why: boundary: WS-DIFFERENCE exactly 0 is allowed; available 0.00, actual (150.00, differs from available) 50.00

scenarios.name: payment-debit-ignores-overdraft
scenarios.why: available 0.00 with a 1000 overdraft limit: the limit is never consulted, so a one-cent payment debit fails '3'

scenarios.name: teller-debit-beyond-overdraft
scenarios.why: teller debit: no funds check at all, balance -1500.00 beyond the 1000 overdraft limit, 'DEB', 'Y'

scenarios.name: teller-debit-negative-balance
scenarios.why: teller debit from an already negative balance (-50.00): allowed, -50.01

scenarios.name: payment-debit-negative-balance
scenarios.why: payment debit from a negative balance: WS-DIFFERENCE -50.01 < 0, 'N' '3'

scenarios.name: payment-debit-mortgage
scenarios.why: payment debit to a MORTGAGE: the debit block's MORTGAGE test (l.330), 'N' '4'

scenarios.name: payment-debit-loan
scenarios.why: payment debit to a LOAN: the debit block's LOAN test (l.332), 'N' '4'

scenarios.name: payment-credit-loan
scenarios.why: payment credit to a LOAN: the second MORTGAGE/LOAN test (l.370), 'N' '4'

scenarios.name: payment-credit-mortgage
scenarios.why: payment credit to a MORTGAGE: the second test's MORTGAGE half (l.368), 'N' '4'

scenarios.name: teller-credit-mortgage
scenarios.why: teller credit to a MORTGAGE: the refusal needs 496, so allowed, 'CRE', -149000.00

scenarios.name: teller-debit-loan
scenarios.why: teller debit (FACILTYPE 1) to a LOAN: allowed, 'DEB', -4510.00

scenarios.name: account-not-found
scenarios.why: SELECT INTO no row: SQLCODE +100, 'N' '1', storm drain WHEN OTHER, no UPDATE

scenarios.name: null-statement-date
scenarios.why: ACCOUNT_LAST_STATEMENT NULL with no indicator: SELECT -305, 'N' '2', storm drain WHEN OTHER

scenarios.name: other-sort-code-not-found
scenarios.why: account 00000010 exists only under sort code 123456; COMM-SORTC is overwritten with the program's own 987654, so +100, 'N' '1'

scenarios.name: zero-amount-payment
scenarios.why: boundary: COMM-AMT 0 is not < 0, so the credit path: 'PCR', amount 0.00, balances unchanged

scenarios.name: max-teller-debit
scenarios.why: the largest debit COMM-AMT holds: balance -9999998999.99 still fits S9(10)V99 and DECIMAL(12,2)

scenarios.name: max-balance-credit-truncates
scenarios.why: boundary: 9999999999.99 + 0.01 overflows S9(10)V99; COMPUTE has no ON SIZE ERROR, so the high-order digit is lost (0.00) and written back

notes: CBSA's debit/credit service (DBCRFUN, LINKed with the PAYDBCR copybook's COMMAREA): COMM-SORTC is overwritten with the program's own sort code (987654) and the account is read by it and COMM-ACCNO with a SELECT INTO from Db2 table ACCOUNT (unqualified: the bind's QUALIFIER, IBMUSER); a failed SELECT gives COMM-SUCCESS 'N' with COMM-FAIL-CODE '1' (+100) or '2' (any other SQLCODE, e.g. -305). COMM-FACILTYPE 496 marks a payment, anything else a teller transaction. A payment debit (COMM-AMT < 0) to a MORTGAGE or LOAN fails '4', and one that would take the available balance below zero fails '3' (the overdraft limit is never consulted); a payment credit to a MORTGAGE or LOAN fails '4'; teller transactions have no checks. Otherwise both balances are adjusted by COMM-AMT (COMPUTE, no ON SIZE ERROR), the row is UPDATEd, COMM-AV-BAL/COMM-ACT-BAL are returned, and a PROCTRAN row is INSERTed: type DEB/CRE with 'COUNTER WTHDRW'/'COUNTER RECVED', or PDR/PCR with COMM-ORIGIN(1:14) for a payment, dated DD.MM.YYYY and timed HHMMSS from the case clock (ASKTIME/FORMATTIME), ref EIBTASKN; then 'Y' '0'. Both tables are compared after every scenario. The COMMAREA is described by the record its caller BNK1CRA passes (SUBPGM-PARMS), the layout of DBCRFUN's PAYDBCR copybook under the caller's names: the generated DTO is the caller's.
